form.label: Callback IP Lookup
form.description: Allows an analyst to query GreyNoise Callback intelligence for a submitted IP, including stage indicators, observation dates, source workspaces, and enrichment details. Requires a Callback-enabled GreyNoise license.

search.query: $token_search_trigger$ | makeresults | eval ip = if(isnull("$tkn_ip_address_escaped$") OR "$tkn_ip_address_escaped$"=="", "", "$tkn_ip_address_escaped$") | gncallback [| makeresults | eval ip_field = "ip" | eval source_workspace = if(isnull("$tkn_source_workspace_escaped$") OR "$tkn_source_workspace_escaped$"=="", "all", "$tkn_source_workspace_escaped$") | return ip_field source_workspace ]

condition.set: No Callback results were returned for the provided IP address
No results were returned due to an unexpected reason: $result.greynoise_error$

search.query: | eval stage_1 = if(greynoise_is_stage_1=="1" OR greynoise_is_stage_1==1 OR greynoise_is_stage_1=="true" OR greynoise_is_stage_1=="True", "True", if(greynoise_is_stage_1=="0" OR greynoise_is_stage_1==0 OR greynoise_is_stage_1=="false" OR greynoise_is_stage_1=="False", "False", greynoise_is_stage_1)) | eval stage_2 = if(greynoise_is_stage_2=="1" OR greynoise_is_stage_2==1 OR greynoise_is_stage_2=="true" OR greynoise_is_stage_2=="True", "True", if(greynoise_is_stage_2=="0" OR greynoise_is_stage_2==0 OR greynoise_is_stage_2=="false" OR greynoise_is_stage_2=="False", "False", greynoise_is_stage_2)) | eval has_files = if(greynoise_has_files=="1" OR greynoise_has_files==1 OR greynoise_has_files=="true" OR greynoise_has_files=="True", "True", if(greynoise_has_files=="0" OR greynoise_has_files==0 OR greynoise_has_files=="false" OR greynoise_has_files=="False", "False", greynoise_has_files)) | table greynoise_ip greynoise_source_workspaces greynoise_first_seen greynoise_last_seen stage_1 stage_2 has_files greynoise_message greynoise_error | rename greynoise_ip AS IP, greynoise_source_workspaces AS "Source Workspaces", greynoise_first_seen AS "First Seen", greynoise_last_seen AS "Last Seen", stage_1 AS "Stage 1", stage_2 AS "Stage 2", has_files AS "Has Files", greynoise_message AS Message, greynoise_error AS Error

| fields greynoise_* | fields - greynoise_error greynoise_enrichment | rename greynoise_* AS * | transpose 0 | rename column AS Field, "row 1" AS Value | where isnotnull(Value) AND Value!="" AND Value!="None" | eval value_count = mvcount(Value) | eval Value = if(value_count > 20, mvappend(mvindex(Value, 0, 19), "... (" . tostring(value_count - 20) . " more values not shown)"), Value) | fields - value_count | sort Field
